features.label: Slope
features.note: Regional terrain at a baseline of about 500 m, averaged over the cell. Not a landing or driving safety assessment.
features.range_note: Percentiles 1 to 99 of the land cells.

features.label: Roughness
features.direction: Height variation in a 3 x 3 pixel window. Lower is smoother.
features.note: Regional terrain at a baseline of about 500 m, averaged over the cell. Not a landing or driving safety assessment.
features.range_note: Percentiles 1 to 99 of the land cells.

features.label: Annual temperature range
features.direction: Warmest minus coldest monthly mean surface temperature.
features.note: Source grid is 0.5 x 0.625 degrees, so sharp mountain relief is smoothed.
features.range_note: Percentiles 1 to 99 of the land cells.

features.label: Day-night temperature range
features.direction: Mean day minus night land surface temperature at the Aqua overpass.
features.source_name: MODIS MYD11A2 v061 land surface temperature
features.note: One 8-day composite from each sampled month of the reference year, read from the Planetary Computer mirror of the NASA product.
features.range_note: lo is the physical floor (0); hi is percentile 99 of the land cells.

features.label: Mean temperature
features.note: Source grid is 0.5 x 0.625 degrees, so sharp mountain relief is smoothed.
features.range_note: Percentiles 1 to 99 of the land cells.

features.label: Precipitation
features.direction: Mean annual precipitation. Lower is more arid.
features.range_note: lo is the physical floor (0); hi is percentile 99 of the land cells.

features.label: Vegetation (max NDVI)
features.direction: Maximum NDVI across the year. 0 means barren.
features.note: One 16-day composite from each sampled month of the reference year, read from the Planetary Computer mirror of the NASA product. Used as a gate, never for ranking.

features.label: Composition
features.source_name: GLiM v1.0 global lithological map, 0.5 degrees
features.note: Bedrock class, not the loose surface layer. The most common class in the cell; a mixed cell lowers confidence. class_map is proposed: intermediate volcanic counts as basaltic, and intermediate plutonic, pyroclastic and metamorphic rock as felsic.
features.range_note: Similarity matrix from spec 5.2, unchanged (B20 pending).

features.label: Elevation
features.direction: Mean height. Off by default because each body has its own datum.
features.note: Moon and Mars heights are relative to their own datums, so this is context only.
features.range_note: Percentiles 1 to 99 of the land cells, leaving out 3425 cells below -430 m (sea floor).
